Class FixedCamera

java.lang.Object
br.edu.unipampa.varzinho.domain.capture.Camera
br.edu.unipampa.varzinho.domain.capture.FixedCamera
public final class FixedCamera extends Camera
A camera bolted to the structure, aimed once when it is installed and never moved.

Its angle is part of what it is, not a setting: pointing it somewhere else means climbing up and remounting it.

  • Constructor Details

    • FixedCamera

      public FixedCamera(String id, String model, Resolution resolution, int bufferSeconds, int angle)
      Builds a fixed camera, switched off, aimed at the angle it was mounted at.
      Parameters:
      id - the identifier, unique across the gym the camera is installed in
      model - the make and model of the equipment
      resolution - the resolution it records at
      bufferSeconds - how many of the most recent seconds the camera keeps
      angle - where it was aimed when mounted, in degrees, from 0 to 359
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the id or model is missing or blank, the resolution is missing, the buffer is not at least one second long, or the angle is outside 0 to 359

  • Method Details

    • captureLastSeconds

      public VideoClip captureLastSeconds(int seconds)
      Description copied from class: Camera
      Freezes the most recent seconds into a clip. Each kind of camera produces one its own way, and a court triggers them all through this single call.

      Every kind keeps one promise: the clip is finished when this returns. A kind that writes a file has written it, so whoever holds the clip may archive it at once, without knowing which kind of camera cut it.

      Specified by:
      captureLastSeconds in class Camera
      Parameters:
      seconds - how much of the recent past to keep
      Returns:
      the finished clip that stands for those seconds
